title: post-tester plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: Describes a post-tester plugin: what it is, what it provides and which permissions it needs. Check it with `pt plugin validate`.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation. Ignored by post-tester.

name.description: Unique plugin id: lowercase letters, numbers and `-`, not starting with `-`, e.g. "totp-generator". Used in `pt plugin approve <name>`, in plugin auth names ("<name>/<method>") and, with `-` replaced by `_`, in MCP tool names.

displayName.description: Human-friendly name shown in the app. Defaults to `name`.

description.description: What the plugin does, in one sentence. Shown to users and AI agents. Must not be empty.

version.description: The plugin's version as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (semantic versioning), optionally with a pre-release or build suffix, e.g. "1.0.0" or "1.0.0-beta.1".

engine.description: post-tester versions the plugin works with. Supported forms: "^0.1.0" (caret range; for 0.x only the same minor version matches), ">=0.1.0", an exact version "0.1.0", or "*". Must include the running post-tester version.

main.description: Entry file, relative to the plugin folder, that does `export default definePlugin({ ... })`. TypeScript (.ts) and JavaScript (.js) are supported. Absolute paths and `..` are not allowed.

provides.description: The plugin types this plugin implements. Each one must match a key passed to definePlugin, and every key must be listed here.

items.description: template-function → templateFunctions, auth → auth, hook → hooks, importer → importers, exporter → exporters, codegen → codegen, viewer → viewers, mcp-tool → mcpTools.

permissions.description: What the plugin may do outside its sandbox. Declare only what it uses; use [] for none. Users approve each permission before it takes effect.

items.description: network:<host> (one host name, without scheme, port or path, e.g. network:api.github.com), network:*.<domain> (every sub-domain, e.g. network:*.example.com; not example.com itself), network:* (any host; avoid), secrets:read (ctx.secrets), fs:read (ctx.fs.read), fs:write (ctx.fs.write).
